content.value: An n-p-n transistor at room temperature has its emitter disconnectd. A voltage of 5 V is applied between collector and base with collector positive, a current of 0.2 μA flows. When the base is disconnected, and the same voltage is applied between collector and emitter, the current is 20 μA. Find out i) α, ii) IE, and iii) IB when the collector current is 1 mA.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
